sourceDescription: Working implementation before its completion commit; exact file hashes below.
command: npx playwright test tests/fill-scale.spec.ts (also included in npm test)
method: One fill and one cancellation per complete fixture per run. Browser development/WebGL; rAF and timer gap proxies, not native presented frames or physical memory. Complete per-layer stored-run hashes are checked outside timed intervals. Filled region is terrain [256,1280) squared. No performance budget pass claimed; uncontrolled background apps/power/refresh. Final dedicated rerun additionally asserts exactly 1,024 complete rows; earlier runs used the same timed implementation.
